# Mendip Maths Tutoring

> One-to-one maths tutoring across the Mendips and Somerset, UK. GCSE and A-Level
> support with tailored learning plans, in-home lessons, and specialist experience
> supporting students with ADHD, autism and dyslexia. Free taster lesson available.

## About

- Founder and tutor: Ryan Garvey, who holds a Mathematics degree (University of Manchester)
  and has 15 years' teaching experience in the UK and overseas across all major exam boards.
- Since 2022, specialised in alternative provision, supporting students with
  diverse learning needs including ADHD, autism and dyslexia.
- Format: one-to-one, one-hour lessons delivered in the student's own home, with
  tailored learning plans, marked homework, feedback and regular low-stress assessments.

## Fees

- Up to GCSE (Key Stage 3 & GCSE maths): £40 per hour
- Up to A-Level (AS & A-Level maths): £45 per hour
- Free taster lesson with no commitment and no payment details needed
- Term-time cancellations with under 48 hours' notice are charged in full;
  holiday sessions need two weeks' notice. Travel outside the catchment may affect fees.

## Catchment

Based in Shepton Mallet, Somerset. Areas covered: Pilton, Evercreech, Bruton, Wells,
Castle Cary, Oakhill, Chilcompton, Stoke St. Michael, Leigh upon Mendip, Radstock,
Midsomer Norton, Frome, Glastonbury, Street. Enquiries from outside the catchment
are considered (travel costs may apply).
